text:
Maria Chen: Quick sync — Q4 demand projection update. We need firm numbers for H200 reservations and fallback plan with L40S. APAC region looks tight. :eyes:
Cheng Li: can you share the updated GPU-hour forecast? I pulled older Q4 numbers and they look optimistic.
Maria Chen: Posted the rough sketch below. main assumptions: +40% peak during promo week, 20% baseline growth, 8h tail latency target for p95.
Maria Chen: ```
region  | model | reserved | est_gpu_hours/mo | notes
US-east | H200  | 120      | 43200            | prefer H200 for throughput
EU-west | H100  | 80       | 24000            | mix H100+L40S for cost
APAC   | L40S  | 40       | 10000            | limited H200 availability
```
Oliver Park: APAC lead times from vendors are 12-18 weeks for H200 right now. H100 is 6-10. L40S is available in 4-6 wks. Procurement flagged a shipping cap in SG.
procurement-bot: FYI: latest PO queue ETA for H200 -> 14 weeks, with a 30% chance of slippage.
Samira Patel: If APAC H200 lead time is 14+ weeks, we should plan L40S bursts there and route high-throughput requests to US/EU with failover. That impacts latency for some customers though.
Cheng Li: Agree. Proposal: reserve critical capacity (50 H200-equivalent) for enterprise customers in US/EU, and create an autoscale pool of L40S in APAC for best-effort traffic.
Maria Chen: Cost check — L40S per-hour is ~0.45x H200 pricing but gives ~0.4x throughput for our models. So cost/quality tradeoff is ~+12% higher cost per unit completed if we overuse L40S for throughput-sensitive workloads.
Oliver Park: Can we quantify throughput: for our Llama-deriv 8k prompt, H200 = ~580 tokens/s, H100 = ~420 tokens/s, L40S = ~220 tokens/s (avg). That drives queueing math.
Cheng Li: I'll run a sim tomorrow (p95 latency vs reserved GPU hours) and share numbers.
Maria Chen: Also need to account for networking: cross-region routing adds ~30-60ms extra for APAC->US. For some SLAs that's unacceptable.
Samira Patel: Ops ask: what's the threshold to flip to dedicated capacity vs hosted fallback? We need a decision rule.
Oliver Park: Suggest: if projected 7-day rolling demand > 70% of reserved capacity for 3 days, trigger auto-burst and procurement-notify. Otherwise use L40S pool.
procurement-bot: Logged action: create tentative PO for 40 H200 for US/EU, tentative delivery Q4 week 8. Hold until finance confirms budget.
Maria Chen: Action items: Cheng runs sim + latency map by EOD tomorrow; Procurement to confirm POs and slippage probabilities; Ops to draft routing policy with thresholds.
Cheng Li: on it. I'll include sensitivity to 10/20/40% slippage scenarios.
Samira Patel: I'll draft the routing policy, will ping @Maria and @Oliver for signoff. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: reminder — infra duty on-call alerted to possible increased alerts during promo week (expected +2x error rate).
Maria Chen: Thanks team — let's reconvene after the sim results.
